name: kubetail
description: Logging tool for Kubernetes with a real-time web dashboard

repo.name: kubetail
repo.description: Real-time logging dashboard for Kubernetes. View logs in a terminal or a browser. Run on your desktop or in your cluster.

readme.summary: Exceptionally clear and comprehensive README with excellent installation options and quick start guides across multiple deployment methods, though lacking troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section for common issues like connection problems, permission errors, or cluster access failures

injection_risks.description: Potential command injection vulnerability in the 'params' variable, which is used to override configuration parameters. An attacker could potentially inject malicious commands by manipulating the input.

security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential command injection vulnerabilities and lack of input validation, but overall it appears to be well-structured and follows best practices for error handling and logging.

sentiment.summary: Kubetail demonstrates excellent community health with active maintainers, clear feature planning, recent momentum around Alpine/packaging support, and low friction for new contributors.

communication.summary: The maintainer's responses are extremely helpful, clear, patient, and technically sound, making them an exemplary model for open-source project maintainers.
